Cross-checked against 'C19PRC_UKW2 survey questionnaire v2.pdf' Q120 (Block: Loneliness) p.84, and the same grid in the W3 Phase 1/Phase 2, W4 Recontacts/Oversamples, W5 Recontacts and W6 Recontacts/Top-ups questionnaires. Processing: data/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_build.py + data/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_crosswalk.py (key loneliness).
note: Item codes Loneliness1-3 are the .sav column names with the wave prefix stripped (W1-W4 W{w}_LonelinessN) or, for W5/W6, the crosswalk's number-preserving rename Loneliness_N -> LonelinessN; no positional step, no recode, no reverse-coding. Variable labels are identical in all six waves ('Please answer the following questions to tell us how you feel about your relationships with other people. - <item>'): the stem went to instructions and the question to item_text, verbatim; 3/3 labels also match the questionnaire grid rows word for word. Wave-renumbering check (batch_718 defect): item N means the same question in every pooled wave -- 1 lack companionship, 2 left out, 3 isolated from others -- in W1, W2, W3, W4, W5 and W6 labels alike. option_text = .sav value labels 1=Hardly ever, 2=Some of the time, 3=Often, identical across all 18 variables and matching the questionnaire column headers. Cross-check (not required for data_labels): .sav wave x item x resp counts match the live table cell-for-cell, 54/54 (6 waves x 3 items x 3 levels); no other codes in the .sav columns; live 41685 rows, 5364 ids. The W1 questionnaire PDF is image-only (94 chars of text) so W1 wording rests on the W1 .sav labels, which match every later wave. Rights: instrument is the 3-item UCLA short form (Hughes et al. 2004), derived from the R-UCLA; instrument_rights_register.csv row UCLA-L = ship (2026-09-20, no quotable restriction; Ben approved) -- applied, not re-derived. English administration. Dictionary Description 'UCLA 3-item Loneliness Scale; waves 1-6' matches the live data (Step 3b OK).

(2020) measures information.docx' and 'C19PRC W4 Supplementary Measures Material.docx' section 2.2.8.3
note: Item codes MABS_<content> are IRW-assigned by data/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_crosswalk.py (key mabs, waves [1,4]) through an explicit CONTENT-KEYED per-wave rename dict, not a number-preserving one: W1 ReligiousBelief1..8 = soul_immortal, misery, holy_books, moral_judgment, praying, scientific_laws, afterlife, indoctrinate; W4 ReligiousBelief1..9 = god_aware (new at W4), misery, holy_books, moral_judgment, praying, scientific_laws, afterlife, indoctrinate, soul_immortal (moved from position 1 to 9). Every pairing checked against the .sav variable labels of both waves: 17/17 wave-specific columns carry the wording their code names, so the batch_718-style wave-renumbering defect is NOT present here -- the crosswalk already handles the W4 insertion. Because the rename is not number-preserving, Step 5b was run anyway: .sav per-column resp counts match the live table cell-for-cell, 85/85 wave x item x resp cells (e.g. W1 soul_immortal 224/327/895/286/289, W4 soul_immortal 409/599/1687/346/826, W4 god_aware 433/593/1204/351/1286); see verify_c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_mabs.R. Live table: 50954 rows, 4621 ids, waves 1 (2013-2023 per item; god_aware absent) and 4 (3867 per item). Label stem 'Please indicate the extent to which you agree with the following statements:' -> instructions (identical in both waves' labels and the W4 questionnaire); remainder -> item_text verbatim, W1 label used where the item exists at W1. Literal-transcription notes: W1 label reads 'The soul is immortal.' and W4 label/questionnaire 'The soul is immortal' (no full stop) -- shipped with the stop; 'our deed on Earth' (singular) is verbatim in both waves' labels and the W4 questionnaire, not corrected. The W1 questionnaire PDF in the deposit is image-only (no text layer), so W1 wording rests on the .sav labels. option_text = .sav value labels 1=Strongly agree, 2=Agree, 3=Neither agree nor disagree, 4=Disagree, 5=Strongly disagree (identical all items, both waves); the W4 questionnaire prints the columns in the opposite visual order (Strongly disagree..Strongly agree) which does not change the coding. Direction corroborated from the .sav: self-identified atheists vs Christians average 4.29 vs 2.86 on praying, 4.39 vs 2.74 on god_aware (W4), 1.91 vs 2.70 on indoctrinate -- only consistent with 1 = Strongly agree, so higher resp = LESS agreement. Items stored raw, no reverse-scoring (the .sav's _R columns are not used by the build). Rights: MABS is the study team's own scale (Alsuhibani, Shevlin & Bentall, 'Atheism is not the absence of religion', Psychology of Religion and Spirituality, doi 10.1037/rel0000425; Shevlin and Bentall are C19PRC PIs); wording copied from the CC BY 4.0 deposit. No fee, permission, NC, ND or no-redistribution clause located; APA article copyright is a notice about the article, not a term on the instrument (PANAS case). Shipped on silence-is-permission (irw#1945); no register row written (rounds may not write ship rows). English administration.
public_note: Response codes run 1 = Strongly agree to 5 = Strongly disagree, so higher values mean less agreement; MABS_god_aware was asked at wave 4 only, and wave 4 moved 'The soul is immortal' from first to last position (item codes follow content, not position)
